source.title: CharacterEngine_FeatureMap (1).xlsx
notes: Workbook rows are source-of-truth metadata, not proof that every referenced PNG exists in the repo.
Pose rows POSE_01 through POSE_06 correspond to the real six-pose 3x2 Reptile Scientist sheet.
AnimationMeta frame ranges are conceptual clip metadata and must not be treated as literal coordinates on the six-pose sheet.

compatibilityRules.Message: Cannot wear round glasses AND goggles simultaneously.
Head goggles conflict with face round glasses.
compatibilityRules.Notes: Use GLA_03 (no eyewear) if HAT_01 is selected.

compatibilityRules.Message: Lab cap may clip with large round glasses frames.
compatibilityRules.Notes: Engine should offset or disable glasses.

compatibilityRules.Message: Red tie requires outerwear layer to anchor behind lapel.
compatibilityRules.Notes: Tie floats without coat — needs OUT_01 or OUT_02.

compatibilityRules.Message: Red tie also compatible with gray lab coat.
Waving hand and holding phone are mutually exclusive arm poses.
compatibilityRules.Notes: Cannot wave and hold phone at same time.

compatibilityRules.Message: Chin rub and phone hold are mutually exclusive.
Chin rub and clipboard hold are mutually exclusive.
Large round eyes pair best visually with round glasses.
Lab coat pairs best with the red tie for the scientist look.
If phone prop is active, waving hand should not also be selected.
compatibilityRules.Notes: Soft version of RUL_08 for UI hint.

compatibilityRules.Message: Only one species base can be active at a time.
compatibilityRules.Notes: MutuallyExclusive flag on CAT_00 enforces this.

compatibilityRules.Message: Wide goggles are thematically tied to lab coat outfit.
compatibilityRules.Notes: Suggest pairing but do not enforce.
